scorchful.title: Scorchful Config
yacl3.config.scorchful:client.doBurningH: Toggle the burning heart temperature display on the health bar
yacl3.config.scorchful:client.doSoakingO: Toggle the soaking display on the health bar
yacl3.config.scorchful:client.doSunHatSh: Toggle the darkening effect of the Sun Hat
yacl3.config.scorchful:client.enableFear: Toggle the darkening and desaturation screen effects from the Heat Stroke status effect.
yacl3.config.scorchful:client.enableHeat: Toggle the blur and wavey-ness screen effects from the Heat Stroke status effect.
yacl3.config.scorchful:client.enableSoun: Toggle the sound effects of temperature, particularly the heart beat
yacl3.config.scorchful:client.enableWetD: Toggle the dripping particles when wet. This setting overrides Frostiful if installed.
yacl3.config.scorchful:client.sunHatShad: Controls how dark the sun hat shading is.
yacl3.config.scorchful:client.version.de: Config version, do not touch! Changing this value may result in unexpected behaviour.
yacl3.config.scorchful:combat.enableDese: Toggles hallucinations when overheating in the desert like boats and flowers.
yacl3.config.scorchful:combat.fearDetect: How much to multiply an entity's (including players) hostile mob detection range by.
yacl3.config.scorchful:combat.fireBallTh: Controls what type of fireball is creating when throwing a fire charge. Small is just like firing from a Dispener and creates a fire on impact. Large is more like a Ghast and creates an explosion, and disabled disables this feature.
yacl3.config.scorchful:combat.fireProtec: Fire Protection heat resistance per level
How much Heat Resistance the Fire Protection enchantment should give, per level of Fire Protection.
yacl3.config.scorchful:combat.impalingDa: How much damage the Impaling enchantment should do to wet entities, per level of Impaling
yacl3.config.scorchful:combat.version.de: Config version, do not touch! Changing this value may result in unexpected behaviour.
yacl3.config.scorchful:compat/dehydratio: Specific settings for Scorchful's builtin compatibility with the Dehydration mod. This is only relevant if you use Dehydration.
Minimum water level required for sweating
The minimum number of water points needed to be able to sweat (similar to how much hunger you need to heal)
Config version, do not touch! Changing this value may result in unexpected behaviour.
yacl3.config.scorchful:heating.coolingFr: How many temperature points to remove each tick from an entity standing on packed or blue ice.
yacl3.config.scorchful:heating.degreesCP: Specifies the number of Celsius/Kelvin degrees the temperature must be above the minimum heat threshold for each one-point increase in player temperature per tick. Must be positive and non-zero.
yacl3.config.scorchful:heating.desc: Specific settings for heat and temperature
yacl3.config.scorchful:heating.enableTur: Enable/disable water breathing from Turtle Armor
yacl3.config.scorchful:heating.environme: Multiplies the final temperature point change of an environment temperature change.
yacl3.config.scorchful:heating.fireballH: The amount of heat to apply to entities when struck by a fire ball / fire charge.
yacl3.config.scorchful:heating.inLavaWar: The temperature change to apply to entities swimming in Lava each tick.
yacl3.config.scorchful:heating.maxPassiv: The maximum scale that the environment can heat heat players to. Given as a percentage from 0 to 1 (0 = 0%, 1 = 100%)
yacl3.config.scorchful:heating.minTemper: Cutoff temperature for overheating in Celsius. Biomes at or above this temperature will apply environment heating to players. May not be less than 25°C.
yacl3.config.scorchful:heating.onFireWar: How much to increase the temperature of entities on fire each tick.
On fire warm rate with Fire Resistance
How much to increase the temperature of entities on fire each tick, when they have Fire Resistance.
yacl3.config.scorchful:heating.passiveHe: How many ticks should occur between applying heat to a player from the environment. Setting this to large values can be used to slow heat down.
yacl3.config.scorchful:heating.powderSno: Powder Snow cool rate when warm
The cooling to apply to entities in Powder Snow each tick (only applies when their temperature is > 0).
yacl3.config.scorchful:heating.striderOu: Strider out of lava cool rate
The cooling to apply only to Striders each tick they are not in Lava
yacl3.config.scorchful:heating.temperatu: Temperature change to apply to players after eating items with the tag #scorchful:is_cooling_food.
yacl3.config.scorchful:heating.turtleArm: Multiply the Lung Capacity attribute of Turtle Armor.
yacl3.config.scorchful:heating.version.d: Config version, do not touch! Changing this value may result in unexpected behaviour.
yacl3.config.scorchful:thirst.aridBiomeS: A multiplier for temperatureFromWetness when the humidity is at or below 20%. This applies to arid climates like Deserts, Badlands, and Savannas, as well as The Nether.
yacl3.config.scorchful:thirst.desc: Specific settings for Scorchful's native thirst system
yacl3.config.scorchful:thirst.extraHumid: A multiplier for temperatureFromWetness when the humidity is at or above 80%. This applies to rainy climates like Jungles, Swamps during the Wet Season; to cave biomes; and to all non-arid biomes when it rains.
yacl3.config.scorchful:thirst.humidBiome: A multiplier for temperatureFromWetness when the humidity is in the range [65%, 80%). This applies to rainy climates like Jungles, Swamps, etc.
yacl3.config.scorchful:thirst.maxRehydra: Multiplier for rehydrationDrinkSize that controls the maximum amount of body water provided by a full suit of Rehydration armor.
yacl3.config.scorchful:thirst.onFireDryD: How many wetness points to remove each tick when on fire.
yacl3.config.scorchful:thirst.rehydratio: The threshold for how much body water needs to be collected before Rehydration will automatically rehydrate the player.
yacl3.config.scorchful:thirst.soakingFro: How much soaking is applied when an entity is hit with any Splash Potion.
yacl3.config.scorchful:thirst.temperatur: How much temperature to remove from wet entities, each tick.
yacl3.config.scorchful:thirst.touchingWa: Touching water or rain wetness increase per tick
How much to increase wetness by when touching water or rain each tick. Note that submerging yourself in water will fully soak you, regardless of what this is set to.
yacl3.config.scorchful:thirst.version.de: Config version, do not touch! Changing this value may result in unexpected behaviour.
yacl3.config.scorchful:thirst.waterFromH: The amount of body water provided by consuming Hydrating food and drink.
yacl3.config.scorchful:thirst.waterFromP: The amount of body water provided by consuming Parching food and drink.
yacl3.config.scorchful:thirst.waterFromR: The amount of body water provided by consuming Refreshing food and drink.
yacl3.config.scorchful:thirst.waterFromS: The amount of body water provided by consuming Sustaining food and drink.
yacl3.config.scorchful:weather.desc: Specific settings for Scorchful's weather-related effects
yacl3.config.scorchful:weather.doSandPil: Enable/disable sand piles accumulating on the ground during sandstorms.
yacl3.config.scorchful:weather.sandPileA: Sets the maximum height of sand piles that can accumulate during sand storms. Maximum value is 8.
yacl3.config.scorchful:weather.sandstorm: Sandstorm Follow Range reduction amount (percent from -1 to +1)
How much to multiply the total follow range of entities on the surface by during Sandstorms. Negative values decrease follow range, positive values increase it.
How much to multiply the total speed of entities on the surface by during Sandstorms. Negative values provide slowness, positive values provide speed.
yacl3.config.scorchful:weather.version.d: Config version, do not touch! Changing this value may result in unexpected behaviour.
